title: One-year follow-up of femtosecond laser-assisted penetrating keratoplasty

groups.description: Lattice dystrophy, no combined procedure (Table 1, patient 1); femtosecond laser-assisted penetrating keratoplasty (IntraLase, zig-square donor and recipient incisions, 10-0 nylon sutures), single surgeon, retrospective case series

Pseudophakic bullous keratopathy, no combined procedure (Table 1, patients 2, 3, 6, 7); femtosecond laser-assisted penetrating keratoplasty (IntraLase, zig-square donor and recipient incisions, 10-0 nylon sutures), single surgeon, retrospective case series

Pseudophakic bullous keratopathy with a pre-existing epiretinal membrane (ocular comorbidity defined before surgery), no combined procedure (Table 1, patient 4); femtosecond laser-assisted penetrating keratoplasty (IntraLase, zig-square donor and recipient incisions, 10-0 nylon sutures), single surgeon, retrospective case series

Corneal scar from a previous chemical injury, combined cataract extraction with IOL implantation (CE-IOL) (Table 1, patient 5); femtosecond laser-assisted penetrating keratoplasty (IntraLase, zig-square donor and recipient incisions, 10-0 nylon sutures), single surgeon, retrospective case series

Fuchs endothelial dystrophy, combined CE-IOL (Table 1, patients 8 and 10); femtosecond laser-assisted penetrating keratoplasty (IntraLase, zig-square donor and recipient incisions, 10-0 nylon sutures), single surgeon, retrospective case series

Laser peripheral iridotomy-induced bullous keratopathy, combined CE-IOL (Table 1, patient 9); femtosecond laser-assisted penetrating keratoplasty (IntraLase, zig-square donor and recipient incisions, 10-0 nylon sutures), single surgeon, retrospective case series

notes: 10 eyes of 10 patients; diagnosis and combined procedure per patient from Table 1 rows 2-11 (patient numbers match Table 2 rows 4-13).
The article states no convention for off-chart acuities (counting fingers, hand motion); every cited cell is numeric and is kept as printed.
Selective suture removal from postoperative month 4; no rejection during the one-year follow-up (Results).
Table 3 (manifest and Sim K astigmatism) and Table 4 (endothelial cell density) are not used; uncorrected acuity is not used.
